sloka: सुवर्णकोट्यो बहुला हिरण्यस्य शतोत्तराः ।अग्रतो भरतः कृत्वा गच्छत्वग्रे समाधिना ।। ७.९१.२१ ॥
transliteration: suvarṇakoṭyo bahulā hiraṇyasya śatottarāḥ ।agrato bharataḥ kṛtvā gacchatvagre samādhinā ।। 7.91.21 ॥

translations.english: Bharata should go forth at the head, having placed many crores of gold and hundreds more of other gold wealth, with careful arrangement.
